notes: Changed the case rule for single-character strings: E3 shows `"a"→"10a"` and `"Z"→"10z"`, so a lone character is lowercased rather than uppercased (the "first char upper" rule only applies when there's a following character to make it a word). Everything else (floor midpoint insertion, first-upper/rest-lower for length ≥ 2) matches all evidence.
